statement: No John Gurn*/Gourn* marriage is recorded anywhere in Hertfordshire between 1600 and 1654. The county set's John Gurney marriages begin at Tring in 1655, with John Gurnett events at Cheshunt in 1567 and St Albans Abbey in 1646 bounding the negative on both sides, so the set is demonstrably carrying seventeenth-century Gurney-variant marriages across the window and simply holds none for a John Gurney. Great Berkhamsted's own Gurney marriages between 1582 and 1722 are all brides. The younger Berkhamsted John's wife therefore cannot be named from county records and cannot be tested against a Mary. A groom who married outside the county would surface in the south-Midlands archdeaconry licence series, which has never been searched.
